name: Ranger Battle Master
body:
Some rangers dedicate themselves almost exclusively to learning a diverse array of combat styles for any situation, at the exclusion of uncovering magical abilities or strategies targeted against specific foes.

Battle Focus (Ex)

As a swift action, you can designate any one creature that you can see as your focus in battle. You receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls and weapon damage rolls against this target. At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.

You can change your battle focus to a different creature you can see as a swift action, or end your battle focus as a free action. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to 1/2 your ranger level (minimum 1) + your Wisdom modifier.

These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

This feature replaces 1st favored enemy.

Second Combat Style (Ex)

At 5th level, you gain a second combat style.

You must choose this style from among those available to rangers, and it cannot be the same as the combat style you selected at 2nd level. You treat your ranger level –4 as your effective ranger level for the purposes of which feats you are able to select from your second combat style. You select one feat from this combat style at 5th level, and one additional feat from it when you reach 10th, 15th, and 20th level. As with your first combat style, you do not need to meet the prerequisites for the feats selected.

This feature replaces 2nd, 3rd, 4th, & 5th favored enemies and spells.
